cache_root.description: The root directory for the build cache.

max_cache_storage_gb.description: The maximum amount of storage (in GB) to use for the cache.

max_records.description: The maximum number of records to store in the cache.

calib_batch_size.description: The batch size that the calibration runs.

calib_batches.description: The number of batches that the calibration runs.

calib_dataset.description: The name or local path of calibration dataset.

calib_max_seq_length.description: The maximum sequence length that the calibration runs.

random_seed.description: The random seed used for calibration.

tokenizer_max_seq_length.description: The maximum sequence length to initialize tokenizer for calibration.

dynamic_batch_moving_average_window.description: The window size for moving average of input and output length which is used to calculate dynamic batch size and max num tokens

enable_batch_size_tuning.description: Controls if the batch size should be tuned dynamically

enable_max_num_tokens_tuning.description: Controls if the max num tokens should be tuned dynamically

copy_on_partial_reuse.description: Whether partially matched blocks that are in use can be reused after copying them.

cross_kv_cache_fraction.description: The fraction of the KV Cache memory should be reserved for cross attention. If set to p, self attention will use 1-p of KV Cache memory and cross attention will use p of KV Cache memory. Default is 50%. Should only be set when using encoder-decoder model.

enable_block_reuse.description: Controls if KV cache blocks can be reused for different requests.

enable_partial_reuse.description: Whether blocks that are only partially matched can be reused.

event_buffer_max_size.description: Maximum size of the event buffer. If set to 0, the event buffer will not be used.

free_gpu_memory_fraction.description: The fraction of GPU memory fraction that should be allocated for the KV cache. Default is 90%. If both `max_tokens` and `free_gpu_memory_fraction` are specified, memory corresponding to the minimum will be used.

host_cache_size.description: Size of the host cache in bytes. If both `max_tokens` and `host_cache_size` are specified, memory corresponding to the minimum will be used.

max_attention_window.description: Size of the attention window for each sequence. Only the last tokens will be stored in the KV cache. If the number of elements in `max_attention_window` is less than the number of layers, `max_attention_window` will be repeated multiple times to the number of layers.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that should be stored in the KV cache. If both `max_tokens` and `free_gpu_memory_fraction` are specified, memory corresponding to the minimum will be used.

secondary_offload_min_priority.description: Only blocks with priority > mSecondaryOfflineMinPriority can be offloaded to secondary memory.

sink_token_length.description: Number of sink tokens (tokens to always keep in attention window).

max_verification_set_size.description: Number of NGrams in verification branch per step.

max_window_size.description: Number of NGrams in lookahead branch per step.

device_cache_percent.description: percent of memory after engine load to use for cache

host_cache_size.description: size in bytes to use for host cache

lora_prefetch_dir.description: folder to store the LoRA weights we hope to load during engine initialization

max_adapter_size.description: max supported adapter size. Used to compute minimum

max_pages_per_block_device.description: Number of cache pages per allocation block (device)

max_pages_per_block_host.description: Number of cache pages per allocation block (host)

num_copy_streams.description: number of streams used to copy weights from host to device

num_device_module_layer.description: number of max sized 1-layer 1-module sets of weights that can be stored in host cache

num_ensure_workers.description: number of worker threads used to copy weights from host to device

num_host_module_layer.description: number of max sized 1-layer 1-module adapterSize=1 sets of weights that can be stored in host cache

num_put_workers.description: number of worker threads used to put weights into host cache

optimal_adapter_size.description: optimal adapter size used to set page width

capacity_scheduler_policy.description: The capacity scheduler policy to use

context_chunking_policy.description: The context chunking policy to use

dynamic_batch_config.description: The dynamic batch config to use

bad_words_ids.description: List of token ids that should not be generated

do_sample.description: Whether to use sampling or greedy decoding

early_stopping.description: Whether to stop generation once all beams have reached the end of their sequence

extended_runtime_perf_knob_config.description: TRT extended runtime performance knob configuration

max_length.description: Maximum length of the generated sequence

max_new_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

min_length.description: Minimum length of the generated sequence

no_repeat_ngram_size.description: Size of the n-grams to avoid repetition

num_beams.description: Number of beams for beam search
